title: Oliver Brocato: from fidget spinners to an $11M TikTok chocolate brand, and why to pick one business and stick to it
summary: Oliver Brocato, a 21-year-old e-commerce founder, explains how years of small ventures led to TABS, a sexually enhancing chocolate built for TikTok that he scaled to about $11M a year. He covers sticking with one business through the early slump, focusing on the first customers, picking the right vehicle, and building a personal brand.

principles.text: Beat shiny object syndrome: pick one business and see it through, because breakthroughs take years and most people quit at the first slump.
principles.quote: the important thing is that you pick one and you stick to it and you see it through because like that is the only way you're going to see the light at the end of the tunnel

principles.text: Early on, ignore the big dream and obsess over the next handful of customers; confidence and momentum follow from each small win.
principles.quote: how do I get my first five customers you got that boom now I'm more confident how do I get my first 50. how do I get my first 500 and then again you let momentum like do the work for you

principles.text: The business you choose matters more than your skill: a great operator can't take a weak product far, while an average one with the right opportunity can rocket.
principles.quote: the vehicle or the business that you choose is actually more important than your ability as an entrepreneur

principles.text: Start from something already viral and build the business around it, designing the product for the channel (TikTok) rather than finding a channel for a product.
principles.quote: I decided to take something that was already viral

principles.text: Early-stage platforms are a distribution arbitrage: creators who haven't monetized yet take deals for almost nothing and audiences aren't saturated with ads.
principles.quote: influencers had never monetized on the platform which meant that you can basically secure deals like for pennies on the dollar

principles.text: Build a personal brand for leverage and access, but stay a business operator first so the content is a byproduct of real work.
principles.quote: as soon as you're on people's Radars like your luck just increases a hundred fold
